title: Showdown staging after Contested
old_text: A Showdown is marked as Staged at a Battlefield when the Contested status is applied to a Battlefield with no current controller.
new_text: A Showdown is marked as staged at a Battlefield in the cleanup after the Contested status is applied to that Battlefield.
explanation: Showdown staging happens in cleanup after Contested is applied and does not require the battlefield to be uncontrolled.
